depends_on.name: ontology_table_row_id
depends_on.documentation: The metadata table row giving this image its data context (e.g. the behaviour plate row carrying its OD600 / CFU / lawn-volume covariates). NOT a subject, and NOT provenance: it is the row the did_v1 `document_id` edge named. Optional -- the babu writer emits an imageStack with a subject and no such row.
